business_problem: centralize siloed customer, sales, finance, and product data fast enough to personalize service, reduce churn, and improve upsell decisions.
solution_summary: IONOS uses Snowflake, Snowpipe Streaming, and dynamic tables on Snowflake to centralize siloed customer, sales, finance, and product data fast enough to personalize service, reduce churn, and improve upsell decisions. Customer care, sales, finance, product, and interaction data from more than 150 sources are centralized in Snowflake so every brand can work from one customer record. IONOS uses Snowpipe Streaming to ingest event-based activity in near real time and dynamic tables to refresh downstream transformations with minimal engineering effort. Service, sales, marketing, and management teams use the shared view to spot churn signals, recommend next-best offers, and analyze transcripts for better customer conversations. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
